prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 连续高行 · 发布计划 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "阶段" · longest unbreakable word 32px · one-line width 67px
  col 2: header "时间" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 44px
  col 3: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "内容" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 736px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示发布计划各阶段的时间、负责人和执行内容，便于跟踪从冻结到复盘的进度。","reading":"读者先按时间和阶段纵向扫描，再横向核对负责人及具体安排；灰度阶段的长内容会形成较高的行，可在这些行内容纳必要的换行。","groups":["阶段和时间共同标识发布进程，适合相邻扫描。","负责人和内容共同说明每个阶段由谁执行、要做什么；内容列承担主要的叙述空间。"],"keep_intact":["日期如 05-06 应保持完整。","负责人姓名应保持完整。","灰度比例中的数字与百分号应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["灰度阶段名称可在文字与比例之间换行。","内容列中的长句可按自然语义换行；较短的内容宜保持单行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [88, 65, 67, 499] · table 720×325px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [88, 65, 68, 498] · table 720×325px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [88, 66, 67, 498] · table 720×325px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 60, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"阶段、日期和负责人都保持单行，三个灰度阶段各占两行，行高一致，便于按时间扫描并横向核对安排。内容列获得了主要空间，短内容也保持单行。","problems":"灰度 1% 的“指标”和灰度 50% 的“命中率”跨行断开，影响长句的连续阅读。内容列右侧较满，而第二行明显较短。","cause":"内容列宽 499px，扣除内边距和边框后文字宽 478px；当前断行位置恰好落在这些词语中间。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"与 r2A 一样，标识列清楚，三个灰度行的高度和节奏一致，姓名、日期及百分比完整。","problems":"长内容仍在“指标”和“命中率”中间断行，整体观感与 r2A 几乎相同。","cause":"负责人列比 r2A 宽 1px，内容列相应缩窄至 498px；这个变化没有带来可见的阅读收益。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"日期、负责人和阶段名称保持完整，灰度行连续排列，读者容易比较各次发布安排。","problems":"长内容的断词问题仍在；时间列多出的空间没有明显改善日期的呈现。","cause":"时间列比 r2A 宽 1px，内容列缩窄至 498px，断行位置基本不变。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"content-first","widths":[78,65,67,509],"change":"将阶段列缩窄 10px，全部让给内容列，检验能否改善长句中的词语断行；灰度阶段名称可能在文字与比例之间换行，但灰度行本身已有两行高度。"},{"name":"stage-room","widths":[98,65,67,489],"change":"将阶段列加宽 10px，使最长阶段名称有更从容的留白；内容列相应缩窄，检验另一组断行位置能否避开词语中间，同时保持灰度行的两行节奏。"}]}
